interpretation.baseline: The positive diagnostic capture has 125 targets / 983 proved leaves / 0 null / 0 structural and is explicitly not canonical.
interpretation.root_recovery_publication: Omitting publication of sealed root recovery in State::on_release produces two unproved VCs in that archived method: recovery presence and final protocol state.
interpretation.omit_original: Removing bytes_root_detaching_terminal_drop(original, ...) from the generated verifier client leaves its caller VC for root descriptor/phase resolution unproved.
interpretation.omit_survivor: Removing bytes_detached_child_terminal_drop(survivor, ...) from the generated verifier client leaves its saved-return Vec/content postcondition unproved.
interpretation.omit_handoff: Removing the DetachedScope handoff assignment from the generated root-detaching helper leaves five postcondition VCs unproved: recovery completion, cursor model/public/observation fields.
interpretation.negative_missing_acquire: Cargo feature negative_missing_acquire disables the Acquire callback in both retained public_shared::shared_drop_checked and AO promotion::release_core; both leave acquired_Payload pending-token goals null. These two leaves arise from one feature control across two bodies, not independent control variants.
interpretation.negative_missing_payload_free: Cargo feature negative_missing_payload_free replaces the physical projection deallocate call with Ghost::conjure in both promotion::free_recovered and public_shared::free_recovered; each method has one null. These two leaves arise from one shared feature control.
interpretation.negative_missing_control_free: Cargo feature negative_missing_control_free replaces the typed Box free-effect helper with Ghost::conjure in both promotion::free_recovered and public_shared::free_recovered; each method has one null. These two leaves arise from one shared feature control.
interpretation.ghost_conjure_caveat: The archived private Std ghost.rs is byte-identical across captures at SHA-256 34d7cb99ab21dbcb197806a3d1107d6d409b575cec880937cd12ca52959039f9 and gives Ghost::conjure #[requires(false)]. The deallocation controls therefore demonstrate proof sensitivity under a deliberately uninhabitable ghost primitive; they are not standalone theorems that a concrete free receipt exists or evidence of a callable runtime implementation.
interpretation.null_caveat: An undischarged VC establishes proof sensitivity only. It is not a solver counterexample or a demonstrated runtime/Rust failure; the semantic controls do not prove event absence as standalone theorems.
interpretation.checker_caveat: Every archive here is diagnostic, with correspondence exit status 2 and generated/correspondence.json status not_run; these controls do not establish source-to-native correspondence or admission.

limitations: The positive baseline capture deliberately has no generated/compiled-inputs members. The root-recovery negative includes five compiled-input capture files; its correspondence remains not_run.
The native source/MIR and generated verifier client must be bound by the separate final correspondence gate; this report does not claim that gate.

Why3 printer stderr contains nonfatal Dynlink warnings for cfg and hypothesis_selection, and parser/axiom warnings. All fifteen print invocations exited 0 and emitted task text; no solver was invoked.
